caption: Binnenhof, The Hague
composition: Across the Hofvijver to the Ridderzaal and the Torentje · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the north side of the Hofvijver the pond fills the foreground and reflects the Binnenhof. The Ridderzaal’s paired round towers sit across the water, and the small octagonal Torentje meets the pond’s edge. It is clear, about 21.9°C, with wind near 9.7 km/h. Banners are not given readable words.
